title: Zero-fill missing days in the revenue chart
description: The revenue chart drew misleading straight lines across days with no orders. `buildDailySeries` now emits an explicit zero for every day in the range.

expected_issues.description: The loop runs while `i <= keys.length`, one past the end of the array, so the series gets an extra point with `date: undefined` and total 0. Use `i < keys.length` (or `keys.map`).
